The battery pack (connector P1M pins 6–8). Reaches the system rail through the 5 mΩ sense resistors R14E/R15E and the battery switch Q5E.
Amplifier supply: the boost controller U1B (Q2B, Q3B, L1B) makes it from VSys, switched in by Q1B. Leaves on connector P2M pins 1–4.
3.3 V for the audio-detection op-amps U1D/U2D: 3V3_STB through R20D and ferrite bead FB1D.
The microcontroller's 3.3 V: 3V3_STB through ferrite bead FB18C, with a capacitor at every VDD pin of U1C.
Standby 3.3 V, made from VSys by the buck U3E (through diode D1E, inductor L2E). Feeds the PD controller, current-sense amp, inverter and the connectors; the microcontroller gets it through FB18C.
5 V made from VSys1 by the buck U4E (inductor L3E). Powers the PD controller's PP5V (VCONN/source) and goes to connector P3M pin 23.
The boost controller U1B's internal gate-drive supply: decoupling only.
The PD controller U1U's internal 1.5 V core regulator: a decoupling capacitor only.
The PD controller U1U's own 3.3 V regulator output. Only powers the EEPROM U2U and the SBU switches Q4U/Q5U — not the microcontroller.

The system rail. The charger U2E makes it from USB (buck-boost Q1E–Q4E, L1E), or connects the battery with Q5E. Every other supply starts here.
